t: Taanit sheni vachamishi vesheni achar hammoadim
s: Taanit sheni vachamishi vesheni achar hammoadim ubo h' seipim: nohagin bimdinot ellu lehitannot sheni vachamishi vesheni achar happesach veken achar chag hassukkot, lepi shechosheshin shemma mittok mishteh vesimchat hammoed bau lide abera, laken mitannin litshuba ulekappara, kemo shemmatzinu beiyyob shelleachar shehiqqipu yeme hammishteh vesimchat banayv heela olot mispar kullam, "ki amar ulay chateu banay vego'". Abal leachar shabuot en nohagin lehitannot, dekevan sheeno ella b' yamim — en lachosh shemma chateu bo. Vedin amirat hasselichot va"anenu" ben "goel" le"rope" uqeriat "vaychal" — yitbaer besiman tqs"v:

Nohagin lehamtin lehitannot achar happesach ad sheyyetze kol chodesh nisan, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tk"t. Veachar hassukkot mamtinin ad sheyyetze kol chodesh tishre, lepi shehu merubbeh bemoadot. Veap shennohagin bimdinot ellu shemmuttar lehitannot betishre achar isru chag, mikkol maqom en rotzin liqboa bo lekattechilla taanit qabua, kevan sheepshar lehamtin lehitannot achar kak:

Venohagin lebarek kol mi sheyyitanneh bh"b achar qeriat hattora beshabbat shellipne bh"b. Umi sheana "amen" al zeh — en tzarik leqabbel od hattaanit bemincha shellipne yeme hattaanit. Umikkol maqom, im achar kak nimlak shello lehitannot — eno mechuyyab lehitannot mechamat aniyyat amen. Veap sheaz hayeta dato lehitannot al yede "amen" zeh — en bekak kelum im lo qibbel alayv hattaanit beperush bepiv, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqs"g:

Venohagin shello lebarek bh"b beshabbat shebbetok nisan o tishre, lepi shebbeoto shabbat mebarekin hachodesh achar qeriat hattora, veen tzarik lomar sheen mebarekin bh"b beshabbat shehu rosh chodesh iyyar o cheshvan, ella mamtinim lebarek beshabbat habba, veachar oto shabbat matchilin lehitannot bh"b. Abal im yesh mila o chatunna beoto shabbat shetztzarik lebarek bo bh"b — mebarekin bo bh"b, ella shennohagin lebarek bemincha achar qeriat hattora:
Im era berit mila o shear seudat mitzva betaanit bh"b — mitzva leekol, veen tzarik hattara kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqs"ch:
